design.method: deterministic marginally balanced discrete space-filling sample

headline.quality_first_rule: Only same-record full-loop finite-shot passes receive application-level hardware targets.

stable_region.definition: factory supply <=100x and 12/12 eligible records agree within each cell
stable_region.interpretation: This is a deterministic robustness region, not the probability of a future technology.

matched_mechanism_replacement.scope: Only point-SAM core cells and matched load/store movement change. The study does not borrow LSQCA's published benchmark speedups.

source.point_sam_cells: n data + one scan + six-cell CR
source.replacement_policy: two-entry LRU CR; lower bound keeps one-qubit operations in memory

application_failure_budget.meaning: split equally across logical, synthesis, and distillation faults

decoder_service_sec.meaning: 1/5/63 us service plus a separately retained 7.8-us communication path

dependency_mode.meaning: source-audited aggregate, group-wave, and serial-evaluation ready widths

factory_supply_multiplier.meaning: factory count only; no published speedup multiplier is borrowed

overlap_rho.meaning: rho=0 uses max(core terms); rho=1 serializes them

shots.meaning: direct replayed sampling with 12 independent replicates per selected case

syndrome_round_sec.meaning: scenario value, not a vendor forecast

t_mode.source: Ross--Selinger leading term plus explicit 16/32-T stresses

tolerance_multiplier.meaning: 0.5x/1x/2x tolerance stress; not free quality recovery

useful_lanes.meaning: hardware lanes capped by dependency-ready repetitions

scope: Balanced deterministic design coverage over direct finite-shot representative cases. Scenario frequencies are not probabilities or forecasts.

trace_aware_logical_lower_bound.scope: Direct finite-shot representative records under strict reliability. ML/Chem/Opt and nonpassing Sim rows are conditional execution lower bounds.
